mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in the unemployment rate above 0.3 percentage points signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances, or walk-forward Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) exceeding 2% signals weakening aggregate demand, which reduces earnings expectations for broad-market equities and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances, or walk-forward Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in the industrial production index (INDPRO) exceeding 0.5% signals contraction in manufacturing output, which reduces earnings growth for cyclically sensitive sectors and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) above 1% combined with a monthly increase in the Housing Starts Index (HOUST) above 3% signals coordinated strength in household demand, which boosts earnings expectations for consumer-sensitive sectors and produces positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.

failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of triggered instances, or walk-forward Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 2-year window.
